query:
query GetClimb(
    $boardName: String!
    $layoutId: Int!
    $sizeId: Int!
    $setIds: String!
    $angle: Int!
    $climbUuid: ID!
  ) {
    climb(
      boardName: $boardName
      layoutId: $layoutId
      sizeId: $sizeId
      setIds: $setIds
      angle: $angle
      climbUuid: $climbUuid
    ) {
      
  uuid
  boardType
  layoutId
  setter_username
  userId
  name
  description
  frames
  angle
  statsAngle
  ascensionist_count
  difficulty
  quality_average
  stars
  difficulty_error
  mirrored
  benchmark_difficulty
  is_no_match
  characteristics
  userAscents
  userAttempts
  is_draft
  is_hidden
  created_at
  published_at
  framesCount
  framesPace
  boardseshDifficulty
  boardseshConfidence
  compatibleSizeIds

    }
  }
